instruction: Right now you're facing towards the cupboards. Now slightly turn left, there is a platform in front of you, move towards the platform. Now you can see an open door to your right, move towards the door and turn right. Now exit the room through the open door which is in front of you. You can see a dining table in front of you, move towards the dining table and turn right, there is a sofa in front of you, move to the other end of the sofa and turn right. Now enter in to the room through the sliding door which is in front of you. You can see a chair in front of you, which is beside the cabinet, move towards the chair and slightly turn left, there is a portrait on the wall in front of you, move towards the portrait and turn left. Now, there is an open door in front of you, move towards the open door and stand in the middle of the room facing towards the wall and it is your end point.
